title: Sisbiota-Mar protocol for benthic community sampling
author: Anaide W Aued
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p2wdqfe

steps.title: Select and photograph reef surfaces
steps.instruction: Select 2m² (1x2m) horizontal surfaces on the reef, avoiding sand and big boulders, at either 1-7 meters (shallow) or 8-15 meters (deep), ensuring areas are 2-5m apart.

substeps.instruction: Photograph the bottom of each 2m² area using a set of five photoquadrats (25x25 cm).

steps.title: Analyze digital photographs
steps.instruction: Analyze the digital photographs using a PC with photoQuad software (http://www.mar.aegean.gr/sonarlab/photoquad/index.php).

substeps.instruction: Lay fifty random points on each image.
Identify the organism underneath each point to the lowest taxonomic level possible.
